_meta.title: Strategy Catalog — machine-testable implementations derived exclusively from the sebuleni-llm ICT knowledge base
_meta.knowledge_constraint: Every component references knowledge-base objects (IDs of the form BEG-/INT-/ADV-Mxx-{C,R,S,EX,REL,NT,AMB,EMP}nn). Where the source leaves a value undefined it is marked 'unspecified'. No thresholds, indicators, or methodology outside the knowledge base were introduced.

field_glossary.strategy_kind: base_model = direct implementation of a KB StrategyObject; variant = documented combination / conditioning of a base model; component = reusable sub-procedure that is not a complete trade on its own
field_glossary.specificity_status: fully_specified | partially_specified — mirrors the KB's own status; 'unspecified_elements' lists what a researcher must freeze before testing (ADV-M18-R02)
field_glossary.direction: long | short | reversal_bidirectional (direction determined at runtime by which pool is swept, always subject to bias filter)

strategies.name: ICT Buy Model — The Eleven Steps

context.htf_bias_required: Daily and 4-hour charts show bullish structure (higher highs and higher lows, P-STRUCT-01) and/or a recently confirmed bullish HTF MSS (P-MSS-01 on the HTF).
context.location: Setup considered stronger when current price is in the discount half (below 50% equilibrium) of the HTF dealing range (P-RANGE-01).
context.other: A nearby, identifiable sell-side liquidity pool below current price (P-LIQ-01).

prerequisites: Step 1 — HTF bullish context confirmed (P-STRUCT-01 on D/4H, or HTF MSS); note HTF dealing range half.
Step 2 — Nearest significant SSL below price marked: recent swing low, equal lows, Asian session low, or previous day's low (P-LIQ-01).
setup_sequence: Step 3 — Liquidity sweep: price trades through the marked SSL (ideally a sharp, brief wick / short-lived push), then shows signs of reversal back above that level (P-LIQ-02).
Step 4 — Bullish displacement: fast, forceful, large-bodied bullish move away from the swept low (P-DISP-01).
Step 5 — Bullish MSS: the displacement produces a candle-body close above a meaningful, relevant short-term swing high on the LTF (5-minute or 15-minute) (P-MSS-01).
Step 6 — FVG / Order Block: mark the FVG left by the displacement candle(s) (P-FVG-01); check whether a bullish OB (last bearish candle before displacement) sits at/near the same zone (P-OB-01).
Step 7 — Retracement: wait, without entering, for price to pull back from post-MSS highs toward the FVG/OB zone.
Step 8 — OTE: Fibonacci on the impulse leg from the swept low to the pre-retracement high (P-FIB-01); require the FVG/OB zone to fall within or close to the 62%-79% band, ideally near 70.5%.

entry.entry_zone: Step 9 — a single price at or near the FVG midpoint (Consequent Encroachment) or the Order Block boundary, inside the confirmed OTE band.
trigger_options: Step 10a — resting limit order at the entry zone.
Step 10b — market entry once price reaches the zone AND shows an additional LTF confirmation (e.g. 1-minute bullish MSS or a rejection candle).

stop_invalidation.trade_level: Stop just beyond the low of the liquidity sweep (Step 3), small buffer (P-STOP-01 option A). A close back below the swept low invalidates the premise.
stop_invalidation.pre_entry_invalidation: If, before entry is reached, price fails to produce a genuine bullish MSS after the sweep, read the move as a genuine breakdown continuation — no bullish trade (BEG-M11-NT01).
stop_invalidation.narrative_level: unspecified in this module (HTF bias change per BEG-M10 / INT-M11-R04).

target.primary: Nearest significant BSL above current price — commonly the displacement high, a prior day/week high, or equal highs (P-TARGET-01 option A).
target.secondary: Additional HTF buy-side pools beyond the primary.

strategies.session: Not restricted in the generic statement; worked example occurs in the London Open Kill Zone (02:18 ET) (BEG-M11-EX01).

stop_buffer.value: unspecified ('just beyond'); example uses 1.08030 vs sweep low 1.08042

position_size.value: from entry-to-stop distance; no % rule in this module — see P-RISK-01

strategies.eligibility_checklist_kb: BEG-M11-S01.eligibility_checklist (8 items) — all must be true
strategies.dependency_rule: BEG-M11-R01 — each link is a dependency, not merely a time sequence (FVG without sweep+displacement is just a gap; MSS without sweep is weaker; entry without target is incomplete).

strategies.name: ICT Sell Model — The Eleven Steps

context.htf_bias_required: Daily and 4-hour bearish structure (lower highs, lower lows) and/or recently confirmed bearish HTF MSS.
context.location: Current price in the premium half (above 50% equilibrium) of the relevant HTF dealing range (P-RANGE-01).
context.other: Nearby identifiable buy-side liquidity pool above current price.

prerequisites: Step 1 — HTF bearish context confirmed; price in premium half.
Step 2 — Nearest significant BSL above price marked: recent swing high, equal highs, session high, or previous day's high (P-LIQ-01).
setup_sequence: Step 3 — Sweep: price trades through the BSL (ideally sharp brief spike above), then shows signs of reversal back below it (P-LIQ-02).
Step 4 — Bearish displacement away from the swept high (P-DISP-01).
Step 5 — Bearish MSS: body close below a meaningful, relevant short-term swing low on the LTF (P-MSS-01).
Step 6 — Mark the bearish FVG left by the displacement (P-FVG-01); check for a bearish OB (last bullish candle before displacement) at/near the zone (P-OB-01).
Step 7 — Wait, without entering, for the retracement up toward the FVG/OB zone.
Step 8 — OTE: Fibonacci from the swept high down to the pre-retracement low; FVG/OB zone within/close to 62%-79%, ideally near 70.5% (P-FIB-01).

entry.entry_zone: Step 9 — at/near the FVG midpoint (CE) or OB boundary inside the confirmed OTE band.
trigger_options: Step 10a — resting limit (short) at the zone.
Step 10b — market short once price reaches the zone and shows an LTF confirmation (1-minute bearish MSS or rejection candle).

stop_invalidation.trade_level: Stop just beyond the high of the sweep (Step 3), small buffer (P-STOP-01 A). Close back above the swept high invalidates.
stop_invalidation.pre_entry_invalidation: No genuine bearish MSS after the sweep -> genuine breakout continuation -> no short (BEG-M12-NT01).
stop_invalidation.narrative_level: unspecified in this module.

target.primary: Nearest significant SSL below — displacement low, prior day/week low, equal lows (P-TARGET-01 A).

strategies.session: Not restricted; worked example at 14:00 ET (BEG-M12-EX01) — outside the named Open kill zones.

parameters.mirror_of: S01-BUY-11STEP (all parameters identical, polarity reversed — BEG-M12-R01, BEG-M12-REL01)

strategies.name: Bullish Discount Framework (dealing-range-conditioned long)

context.htf_bias_required: HTF bias bullish (or at least not bearish) — P-BIAS-02.
context.location: Price trading in the discount half of the active dealing range, or has just raided SSL and is returning into discount (P-RANGE-01).
context.other: Active dealing range selected per INT-M06-R01 (tested/engineered boundaries; aligned with narrative timeframe; nested inside HTF container).

prerequisites: Identify the dealing range; mark high, low, equilibrium; confirm price in (or returning to) discount.
Note sell-side liquidity that has been or is being raided (P-LIQ-01/02).
Name the DOL: internal BSL first, external BSL consistent with HTF narrative (P-DOL-01).
setup_sequence: Bullish displacement (P-DISP-01) and an internal OR external MSS (P-MSS-01/02) after the SSL raid.
Locate the PD array created by that displacement — FVG and/or OB — that sits in discount (P-FVG-01, P-OB-01, INT-M06-R03).

entry.entry_zone: The discount PD array created by the displacement.
trigger_options: Retracement into the array, refined by Consequent Encroachment (P-FVG-01) or by LTF confirmation.

stop_invalidation.trade_level: A decisive close back below the origin of the bullish displacement (P-STOP-01 B), or below the dealing-range low if that low was the structural reference.
stop_invalidation.narrative_level: Dealing-range low / HTF invalidation per INT-M11-R04.

target.primary: First internal buy-side liquidity (IRL).
target.secondary: External buy-side liquidity (ERL) consistent with the DOL (P-TARGET-01 B).

strategies.session: unspecified (INT-M06-S01); INT-M06-NT01 forbids entries deep inside prolonged contraction without emerging displacement.

deep_discount_preference.value: outer ~20-25% of range (79%/21% fib region) highest conviction

unspecified_elements: which structural reference (displacement origin vs range low) is the stop — both documented
strategies.worked_example: INT-M06-EX01 (range 1.0800-1.1000; arrays 1.0845-1.0865 in discount; counter-example at 1.0960 premium rejected)

strategies.name: Bearish Premium Framework (dealing-range-conditioned short)

trigger_options: Retracement into the array (CE refinement or LTF confirmation, by symmetry with INT-M06-S01).

stop_invalidation.trade_level: Decisive close back above the origin of the bearish displacement, or above the dealing-range high.
stop_invalidation.narrative_level: Range high / HTF invalidation (INT-M11-R04).

strategies.name: Power of 3 (AMD) Daily Template — Asia accumulation / London manipulation / distribution entry

context.htf_bias_required: Not explicit in BEG-M09-S01; INT-M10-R04 / ADV-M08-R04: highest quality when the daily PO3 direction aligns with weekly/daily bias and price is in discount (bullish) / premium (bearish) of the controlling range. A PO3 opposing HTF bias is lower probability — favour the HTF story.
context.location: Controlling-range half consistent with the expected distribution direction (P-RANGE-01).
context.other: An identifiable opening price for the period (daily open) and a defined Asian range (P-TIME-02).

prerequisites: Identify the day's opening price (ADV-M07-C03).
Mark the Accumulation range = Asian session high/low near the open (P-PO3-01, P-TIME-02). Observe only — no trades inside the range (BEG-M09-NT01).
setup_sequence: Manipulation: price breaks one boundary of the accumulation range — an unusually sharp, brief spike consistent with a stop-run (classic: London Open sweep of one Asian-range side) — then shows signs of reversing shortly after (P-LIQ-02, P-PO3-01). Do not trade the manipulation itself as the trend (ADV-M08-R03).
Distribution confirmation: LTF MSS in the direction opposite to the manipulation (P-MSS-01), following displacement (P-DISP-01).
Locate the PD array (FVG/OB) created by the distribution displacement (P-FVG-01/P-OB-01) — the retracement into it is the entry window (INT-M10-R03, ADV-M08-R03).

entry.entry_zone: Retracement into the distribution-displacement PD array (FVG/OB/OTE), in the direction of the confirmed distribution.
trigger_options: After LTF MSS confirmation only — never during the manipulation move (BEG-M09-S01, BEG-M09-NT02).

stop_invalidation.trade_level: Not restated in BEG-M09-S01 (deferred to Module 7 / Modules 11-12). KB-documented choices: below/above the manipulation extreme (sweep extreme, P-STOP-01 A) or the displacement origin (P-STOP-01 B); INT-M11-EX01 daily invalidation 'below the Asian low / origin of the expected bullish displacement'.
stop_invalidation.pattern_invalidation: If the move beyond the accumulation range fails to reverse within a reasonable number of candles -> genuine breakout, AMD read invalidated, no distribution trade (BEG-M09-R02). PO3 failure modes: sweep-and-go; both sides swept with doji/inside close; HTF opposing force reverses distribution (INT-M10-R05, ADV-M08-R05).

target.primary: Liquidity resting on the opposite side of the original accumulation range (e.g. Asian high for a bullish day).
target.secondary: Beyond — the daily / HTF Draw on Liquidity (INT-M10-R01, P-DOL-01).

timeframe.period: Daily (also fractal: session, week, month — BEG-M09-R01)
timeframe.ltf_confirmation: LTF MSS timeframe unspecified ('commonly' MSS on LTF; 5-minute used in session examples)

strategies.session: Asia = accumulation (observe); London (esp. open) = manipulation; London continuation / New York = distribution (BEG-M09-R03, INT-M10-R01, ADV-M08-R01). Tendency, not law — around major news the phases may shift sessions.
strategies.direction: reversal_bidirectional — long if manipulation sweeps BELOW the accumulation low and reverses; short if it sweeps ABOVE the high and reverses; must be consistent with HTF bias filter

opening_price_definition.value: daily open (ADV-M07-C03); New York midnight open flagged as thinner-support reference (ADV-M07-AMB01)

accumulation_range_definition.value: Asian session range; Asian window per P-TIME-01 alternatives

strategies.worked_example: INT-M10-EX01 (Asian 1.0810-1.0850; London sweep to 1.0795; distribution higher through 1.0850)

strategies.name: Judas Swing — London Open Kill Zone reversal of an Asian-range sweep

context.htf_bias_required: Not explicitly stated in the London Open section (BEG-M08-S01 missing_elements); implied alignment with Modules 2/10 bias. Intermediate/advanced text requires the daily narrative to name which Asian side is expected to be raided (INT-M11-C03, ADV-M10-R03) — treat HTF alignment as a required filter when testing the conditioned variant S19/S20, and as a stratification variable when testing this base form.
context.location: unspecified in this module.
context.other: A completed Asian Range with high and low marked before the London window opens (P-TIME-02).

prerequisites: Time check: current time inside the London Open Kill Zone (P-TIME-01 london_open_kz_ET).
Asian Range high and low marked (P-TIME-02).
setup_sequence: Price sweeps beyond one of the two Asian-range levels (P-LIQ-02).
Displacement in the OPPOSITE direction to the sweep (P-DISP-01).
Market Structure Shift on a lower timeframe (commonly the 5-minute) in the reversed direction (P-MSS-01).
Reclaim test: confirm price does not reclaim the swept level within roughly 2-3 candles on that LTF; if it does, reclassify as a genuine breakout — no Judas trade (BEG-M08-R06).
The FVG left by the displacement, if one forms, is the entry zone (P-FVG-01).

entry.entry_zone: The displacement FVG in the reversed direction (per Module 7 Entry Zone: CE / OTE overlap).
trigger_options: Retracement into the FVG (deferred to BEG-M07-S01 mechanics: limit at zone or LTF confirmation).

stop_invalidation.trade_level: Deferred to Module 7 Entry Zone: beyond the 100% swing extreme = the sweep extreme (P-STOP-01 A/B coincide here).
stop_invalidation.pattern_invalidation: Reclaim of the swept level within ~2-3 LTF candles -> genuine breakout, no trade (BEG-M08-R06).

target.primary: Deferred to Module 7: prior opposing liquidity pool — the opposite Asian-range boundary and the liquidity beyond it (BEG-M08-C06 example: SSL below the Asian low).
target.secondary: Negative Fibonacci extension (-27% / -62%) of the displacement leg (BEG-M07-R03).

timeframe.ltf_structure: 5-minute (commonly cited for MSS and reclaim count)

strategies.session: London Open Kill Zone ~02:00-05:00 ET (alt. 02:00-04:00) (BEG-M08-R02).
strategies.direction: reversal_bidirectional — short after a sweep of the Asian HIGH; long after a sweep of the Asian LOW

reclaim_definition.value: unspecified — KB does not define the direction/price test that constitutes a 'reclaim'; must be frozen before testing

unspecified_elements: HTF bias precondition (not stated in this section)
exact stop and target (deferred to Module 7)
strategies.worked_example: BEG-M08-C06 example: Asian 100-103; 02:30 ET spike to 104.5; displacement down through 100; 5m bearish MSS; FVG 100.5-101.5 = short entry zone.

strategies.name: OTE Entry Zone Construction (reusable entry/stop/target component)

context.htf_bias_required: HTF bias supporting the direction of the measured swing (P-BIAS-01/02).
context.location: OTE band must lie in the correct premium/discount half of the dealing range; if it falls on the wrong side of equilibrium the setup is lower quality / needs extra confluence (INT-M07-R03).
context.other: A genuine displacement-confirmed impulse leg exists (P-DISP-01) — not a slow move; per the book's working definition the leg produced an MSS (P-MSS-01).

prerequisites: Confirm HTF bias, genuine displacement, and MSS establishing the new leg.
Preferably a liquidity raid preceded the displacement (INT-M07-C04) — without it the OTE retracement is lower probability.
setup_sequence: Anchor Fibonacci on the displacement leg (100% at origin, 0% at termination) (P-FIB-01; anchor price-type per parameter).
Mark 62%-79% band with emphasis on 70.5%.
Wait, without entering, while price pulls back (BEG-M07-NT01).
Once price trades into the band, check confluence: does an OB, FVG, or Breaker overlap the band? (P-OB-01, P-FVG-01, P-OB-02; INT-M07-C05/C06).
Wait for an LTF confirmation signal at/near the zone (signal type not precisely defined in Module 7 — developed as LTF MSS in Modules 11-12).

entry.entry_zone: Near the confirmed reaction point — often the 70.5% level or the boundary of the overlapping PD array (for OB∩OTE the overlap zone is the refined entry).
trigger_options: LTF confirmation signal at/near the zone (rejection candle / LTF MSS / reaction at 70.5%).

stop_invalidation.trade_level: Just beyond the 100% level (original swing extreme) (P-STOP-01 B). For OB∩OTE, the more conservative of the OB extreme or the 79% level is a documented alternative (INT-M07-C06).
stop_invalidation.pattern_invalidation: OTE failure: price enters the band then closes beyond the 100% origin -> idea invalidated; do not average (INT-M07-R04).

target.primary: Prior opposing liquidity pool.
target.secondary: Negative extension -27% or -62% beyond the 0% level (P-TARGET-01 C).

timeframe.any: OTE is fractal (BEG-M07-C04); most powerful when LTF OTE aligns with HTF trend.

strategies.session: unspecified in Module 7; INT-M07-NT01 (6) de-emphasises OTE in low-volatility periods with no kill-zone alignment.
strategies.direction: long or short (direction of the measured leg)

anchor_price_type.value: body-to-body (BEG-M07-R01) vs sweep-wick extreme as origin (INT-M07-R01) — CONFLICT, both documented

retracement_depth_class.value: shallow <=50% (tradeable only with high-quality array + strong HTF, inferior R:R); standard 62-79%; deep >79%

unspecified_elements: exact LTF confirmation signal (deferred to Modules 11-12)
strategies.empirical_claim_attached: BEG-M07-EMP01 — secondary sources cite ~55-60% standalone OTE success, 'notably higher' with OB/FVG confluence (hedged, unverified). Tested in CT-06.

trigger_options: Limit at the finalized entry zone, or market on LTF confirmation (BEG-M13-C07).

stop_invalidation.narrative_level: Daily bias invalidation.

strategies.name: Advanced Buy Model — Variation A: Classic FVG / OTE Continuation

context.htf_bias_required: Daily (or higher) bias bullish and not invalidated; a complete bias statement naming the buy-side DOL, controlling range location, structural status, PO3 phase, time window, invalidation and conditioning event (ADV-M10-R01, P-BIAS-02).
context.location: Price in discount of the controlling dealing range, or has just raided SSL and is returning into discount (P-RANGE-01, ADV-M02-R01).
context.other: Expected kill zone supports the phase (manipulation complete, distribution active) (ADV-M08-R03).

prerequisites: Narrative stack written pre-session (monthly -> weekly -> daily) (ADV-M09-R03).
Model permission: only long models eligible under bullish bias (ADV-M10-R07); Variation A authorised when displacement left a clean FVG/OB in discount and OTE aligns (ADV-M11-R02).
Eligibility checklist ADV-M11-R01 passes in full.
setup_sequence: SSL raid — the named origin pool (often relative equal lows or the session/Asian low) is swept (P-LIQ-02).
Bullish displacement + MSS (internal or external as required) (P-DISP-01, P-MSS-01/02, ADV-M04-R03).
FVG (and/or OB) forms in discount from that displacement (P-FVG-01, P-OB-01); array unmitigated.
Retracement begins toward the array (repricing inside an intact delivery leg, ADV-M06-R02).

entry.entry_zone: FVG / Consequent Encroachment / OTE of the displacement leg (refinement hierarchy ADV-M16-R03: CE of a high-quality FVG inside an HTF array > unmitigated FVG/OB in discount > OTE overlapping FVG/OB).
trigger_options: LTF confirmation gate: liquidity event + displacement + MSS printed on the execution timeframe before entry (ADV-M16-R02); do not enter merely because price touched the array (ADV-M16-NT01).
Pre-entry checklist P-GATE-01 must pass.

stop_invalidation.trade_level: Decisive close below the displacement origin, or below the far side of the entry array (P-STOP-01 B/C); alternatively beyond a recent LTF swing whose breach negates the internal MSS (D). Defined before entry; never widened (ADV-M16-R04).
stop_invalidation.narrative_level: Daily or weekly invalidation as defined in the bias statement — retires all long models until a new bias is constructed (ADV-M11-R03, ADV-M10-R05).

target.primary: First partial at the nearest significant IRL / intermediate pool in the DOL direction (predetermined fraction).
target.secondary: Runner to the named buy-side DOL (terminal); runner closed on target, on narrative invalidation, or by a structure-tied trailing rule (ADV-M16-R05, ADV-M16-R06).

timeframe.htf: Monthly/weekly/daily narrative; controlling range weekly or daily

strategies.session: The kill zone the daily narrative assigned to distribution/continuation (typically London Open or New York Open); entries outside that window are skipped or need extra confluence (ADV-M16-R07).

rr_filter.value: R:R is recorded as an outcome, not used as a primary filter

strategies.attribution_note: Skeleton is ICT_primary (ADV-M11-S01 attribution); the 'Variation A' label is the book's pedagogical construct, not an official ICT model name (ADV-M11-AMB01).

strategies.name: Advanced Buy Model — Variation B: Breaker Continuation

context.htf_bias_required: HTF bias remains bullish (bias statement intact).
context.location: The Breaker sits in discount of the controlling range.

strategies.name: Buy Model conditioned to the London Open Kill Zone — Asian-low sweep as the SSL origin (conditional daily bias)

context.htf_bias_required: Weekly and daily bias bullish (P-BIAS-02/03) with price in discount of the controlling range and a named buy-side DOL; daily narrative written before London Open stating: 'bullish toward [DOL] ONLY AFTER London sweeps the Asian low and prints displacement + MSS higher; until then no long models are authorised' (ADV-M10-R03, INT-M11-EX01).
context.location: Discount of the daily (and weekly) range (INT-M10-EX01, ADV-M14-C06).
context.other: Asian range complete and marked; its low is the expected manipulation target (ADV-M07-R04: Asian high/low most likely raided at London Open).

prerequisites: Daily conditional bias statement written pre-London (P-BIAS-03, ADV-M10-R03).
Asian range high/low marked (P-TIME-02); optional secondary SSL layer: prior day's low just beneath (BEG-M11-EX01 Step 2).
DOL named: Asian high / internal BSL as intermediate, daily/weekly BSL as terminal (P-DOL-01).
setup_sequence: Inside the London Open Kill Zone: price sweeps the Asian low (and any secondary SSL layer) (P-LIQ-02) — the daily PO3 manipulation (P-PO3-01).
Bullish displacement away from the swept low (P-DISP-01).
Bullish MSS on the 5-minute (or 15-minute) chart with a body close above the relevant short-term high (P-MSS-01).
Judas reclaim test: price does not reclaim the swept level within ~2-3 LTF candles (BEG-M08-R06).
Mark the London-created bullish FVG / OB in discount (P-FVG-01, P-OB-01); Fibonacci from the sweep low to the displacement high — FVG/OB should overlap the 62-79% band (P-FIB-01).

entry.entry_zone: CE of the London-created FVG (or OB boundary) inside the OTE band, in discount.
trigger_options: Limit at CE (BEG-M11-S01 Step 10a) OR market on 1-minute bullish MSS / rejection at the zone (Step 10b).
Timing: retracement during the remainder of the London kill zone or early New York (INT-M09-EX01).

stop_invalidation.trade_level: Beyond the swept Asian low (P-STOP-01 A) — or, alternatively documented, below the London displacement origin (INT-M09-EX01: 'depending on the exact structural reference chosen'). INT-M12-EX01 places the stop beyond BOTH the displacement origin and the Asian low.
stop_invalidation.pattern_invalidation: No bullish MSS after the sweep -> London expanding lower = genuine breakdown; no long (BEG-M11-NT01). Sweep-and-go through the Asian low = PO3 failure (INT-M10-R05).
stop_invalidation.narrative_level: Daily bias retired if London closes below the daily invalidation (Asian low / displacement origin) — reassess before New York (INT-M11-EX01).

target.primary: Asian range high / displacement high / first internal BSL (partial, e.g. INT-M12-EX01 partial at internal liquidity).
target.secondary: Daily / weekly buy-side DOL (runner), typically delivered in New York (INT-M09-EX01, INT-M10-EX01).

strategies.session: London Open Kill Zone 02:00-05:00 ET (alt. 02:00-04:00); entry may extend into early New York (INT-M09-R06: 'clear daily bias + Asian range ready to be swept -> London Open is often the first opportunity').

stop_reference.value: Asian low vs displacement origin vs beyond both

strategies.worked_example: BEG-M11-EX01 (02:18 ET sweep of Asian low 1.08120 + prior-day low 1.08050 to 1.08042; displacement; 5m MSS; entry 1.08118; stop 1.08030) and INT-M12-EX01 (entry 1.0865; stop 1.0810; partial 1.0920; runner 1.1000; BE after new higher low).

strategies.name: New York continuation entry — retracement into the London-created displacement array (no new NY sweep required)
source_concepts: Session Expansion, Retracement, Continuation and Reversal (INT-M09-C06)

context.htf_bias_required: Daily/weekly bias aligned with the London displacement direction; DOL not yet reached (P-BIAS-02/03, P-DOL-01).
context.location: London-created array sits in the correct half of the controlling range.
context.other: London has ALREADY delivered the conditioning sequence: Asian-range sweep -> displacement -> MSS -> FVG/OB left behind (the London manipulation + first expansion). New York's classic role is to continue/expand that distribution, especially in the London-New York overlap; 'many of the highest-quality continuation entries (FVG/CE retracements) occur in early New York after London has conditioned the market' (ADV-M14-R03).

prerequisites: Confirm London profile = Manipulation (sweep + opposite displacement + MSS) or Continuation (ADV-M14-R02); update the daily narrative at London close / NY open (ADV-M14-R03).
London-created FVG/OB is still unmitigated and price has not left it behind (ADV-M16-R03 'do not chase').
Time inside the New York Open Kill Zone (P-TIME-01).
setup_sequence: Price retraces from the London expansion high/low back toward the London FVG / OB / OTE (retracement phase, INT-M09-C06).
Confirm structure still supports continuation: no opposing displacement + external MSS on the return (else the return is 'rebalancing that signals change' — narrative rewrite, ADV-M06-R02).

entry.entry_zone: CE of the London FVG (preferred, ADV-M16-R03) / OB boundary / OTE of the London leg.
trigger_options: Option 1 (Beginner/Intermediate form): resting limit order at CE — INT-M09-EX01 'entry: retracement into the London-created FVG/OTE during ... early New York'.

Option 2 (Advanced form): require an LTF confirmation at the array (local sweep -> displacement -> MSS) before entry — ADV-M16-R02 / ADV-M16-NT01 ('do not enter as soon as price reaches the array without LTF confirmation'). The two documented triggers are compared in CT-19.

stop_invalidation.trade_level: Decisive close back below/above the London displacement origin or the swept Asian extreme (INT-M09-EX01), or beyond the far side of the London array (P-STOP-01 B/C).
stop_invalidation.narrative_level: Daily invalidation; a New York reversal with external MSS + opposing liquidity targeting retires the continuation idea (ADV-M14-R03).

target.primary: Partial at internal intraday liquidity (e.g. London high/low already taken -> next internal pool).
target.secondary: Daily buy-/sell-side objective / HTF DOL (INT-M09-EX01: 'New York continues the expansion toward the daily buy-side objective; partial profits at internal liquidity; remainder held toward the HTF target').

setup_sequence: At the expected liquidity event (origin-pool raid inside the kill zone), compare swings across the two instruments (P-SMT-01): bullish SMT if one prints a lower low and the other a higher low; bearish SMT if one prints a higher high and the other a lower high.

Instrument selection (ADV-M13-R03): bullish SMT -> prefer the instrument that HELD the higher low; bearish SMT -> prefer the instrument that printed the LOWER high — subject to which offers the cleaner array and better own-narrative alignment.
Require subsequent displacement + MSS on the traded instrument in the SMT-implied direction (SMT without MSS is only a warning) (ADV-M13-R04).
Proceed with the Variation A array entry in the correct half of the range (ADV-M13-R04: SMT does not replace the array or the P/D filter).

During weekly accumulation, treat early-week directional signals with more caution: stand aside or apply reduced size (INT-M10-R02; ADV-M08-R03 'Accumulation -> generally stand aside').
Then run the authorised daily model unchanged.
